target_description: Clean-room Centipede-inspired arcade game, touch-first and playable on iPhone Safari; deployed via GitHub Pages at https://github.com/wdavidpence/cenitpede-clone

checklist.item: Phase 0 baseline — repo identity and architecture plan documented
checklist.notes: README.md present; docs/architecture.md and docs/project-plan.md authored

checklist.item: Phase 1 vertical slice — playable game loop with player, mushrooms, centipede, collisions, scoring
checklist.notes: Game loop fixed (rAF single chain, timing reset on restart). Three-way shooting implemented per architecture. All core systems verified: spawn/update/render/collision/cleanup/scoring/game-state paths confirmed in diff audit. Remaining 0.10 for browser visual verification of angled bullet positioning.

checklist.item: Phase 2 enemy ecology — segment behavior, head turns, spider/flea/scorpion interactions
checklist.notes: Spiders, fleas, scorpions implemented with spawn/movement/collision/scoring/cleanup. Centipede head turns at mushrooms/walls, tail follows predecessor. All three enemy types confirmed in code. Under-scored in prior pass.

checklist.item: Phase 3 rules and cabinet feel — scoring tuning, audio, particles, HUD
checklist.notes: 5 Web Audio sound effects (fire, mushroom_hit, enemy_hit, player_damage, wave_transition, game_over). Particle FX system with 80-particle cap and burst spawning. Screen-flash overlays. HUD shows score, lives, wave, high score with localStorage persistence. Missing: dedicated audio variants, scoring breakdown screen.

checklist.item: Phase 4 iPhone Safari hardening — touch-action, safe-area, orientation
checklist.notes: Architecture specifies aspect-ratio and padding strategy for safe areas; viewport-fit=cover; touch-action:none on controls

checklist.item: Autonomous loop infrastructure — STATE.json + supervisor.sh + docs/autonomous-loop.md

last_test_report.details: Scorecard: syntax OK, smoke PASS, all 9 gameplay markers present. Syntax check: inline JS compiles without error. Diff audit: spawn/update/render/collision/cleanup/scoring/game-state paths verified.

next_action: Phase 3 polish: add wave-transition audio variation per wave number, tune centipede speed scaling for early waves, and verify angled bullet visual alignment in browser. Then harden Phase 4 touch controls for edge-case swipe-off scenarios.
